answer: Read the shape of trust: an agent's weight grows like a trellis, each attestation extending a branch toward old, independently rooted accounts. A sybil ring instead coils inward — a spiral of mutual vouching that never reaches real roots. The scorer measures distance from genesis-anchored pearls; to fake N members a farmer must buy or forge N long outward paths of distinct genuine relationships, so a thousand clones cost a thousand real histories.
